title: A solid accent button on a Space page reads white, gold included
detail: Owner ruling 2026-10-28 (words: flip the accent button label to white). frequencyAccentVars now returns white for --space-accent-on on every picked accent except a near-white fill (under 1.5 to 1 against white), which keeps the ink. Alli Rae gold buttons were dark. The pastel member-action pill is untouched. White on a light gold is below AA, accepted by the owner as with ADR-1031.

verify.evidence: accent-frequency test pins yellow white and near-white ink.
